**Issuing details:**
- **Issuing authority:** DELTA, OIML Issuing Authority DK3 (Denmark)

- **Test report:** DELTA, DK, No. DANAK-1916850, dated 12-09-2016 (60 pages)

This certificate applies to a **non-automatic weighing instrument** (indicator) under the OIML R76/2006 standard. The software identification details are deferred to page 3.

# OIML Certificate N° R76/2006-DK3-17.09 — Page 3 of 3

## Content Transcription

**The software consists of a model depending part with an identification and a common software with a version number.**

The software identification is displayed during the power-up sequence of the instrument and shall have the following values.

| MODEL NAME | APPLICATION | SOFTWARE IDENTIFICATION |
|------------|-------------|------------------------|
| VGM | WEIGHING | CE020 |
| VGW | CHECKWEIGHING | CE004 |
| NGP | PRICE COMPUTING | CE005 |
| VGC | PARTS COUNTING | CE006 |
| VDM | WEIGHING | CE011 |
| VDW | CHECKWEIGHING | CE012 |
| VDP | PRICE COMPUTING | CE013 |
| VDC | PARTS COUNTING | CE014 |
| VOM | WEIGHING | CE007 |
| VOWK | CHECKWEIGHING | CE008 |
| VOP | PRICE COMPUTING | CE009 |
| VOC | PARTS COUNTING | CE010 |

The common software, which version can be seen using the setup command Fn1, has the following approved version: **1.02xx**, where xx can be from 00 to 99 and covers differences in non-legal applications.

---

*Page 3. This certificate includes 3 pages*

**DELTA**
Venlighedsvej 4, 2970 Hørsholm, Denmark · Tel.: +45 7219 4000 · Fax: +45 7219 4001 · E-mail: weighing@delta.dk · www.madebydelta.com

**Summary:** This final page of the certificate specifies the approved software identification codes (CE0xx) for three instrument families — VG series, VD series, and VO series — each covering weighing, checkweighing, price computing, and parts counting applications. It also notes the approved common software version is 1.02xx (with xx ranging from 00–99), verifiable via the Fn1 setup command.
